an4.208:1.1: pāpañca vo bhikkhave desissāmi pāpena pāpatarañca
an4.208:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco micchādiṭṭhiko hoti …pe… micchāñāṇī hoti. micchāvimuttī hoti.
an4.208:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā ca micchādiṭṭhiko hoti, parañca micchādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti …pe… attanā ca micchāñāṇī hoti, parañca micchāñāṇe samādapeti.
an4.208:3.3: attanā ca micchāvimuttī hoti, parañca micchāvimuttiyā samādapeti.
an4.208:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco sammādiṭṭhiko hoti …pe… sammāñāṇī hoti. sammāvimuttī hoti.
an4.208:5.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā ca sammādiṭṭhiko hoti. parañca sammādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti. …pe… attanā ca sammāñāṇī hoti. parañca sammāñāṇe samādapeti.
an4.208:5.3: attanā ca sammāvimuttī hoti. parañca sammāvimuttiyā samādapeti.
